text:
The Corvane E3 electric delivery van can travel 510 kilometres on a single charge, according to figures published on 14 March 2025.

The range was set out in Corvane Motors' Technical Specification Bulletin CM-E3/07, released at the Veldmarsh Commercial Vehicle Expo. The figure applies to a WLTC-style combined test cycle and to the van's 92 kWh battery pack.

Ingrid Halvorsen-Pell, Head of Vehicle Certification at the Norveld Transport Standards Authority, said the published number follows a recognised testing format. "A combined-cycle figure gives fleet operators a consistent basis for comparing vehicles," she said.

The bulletin was among the technical documents made available to trade visitors at the expo. Corvane Motors listed the 510 km range alongside the battery capacity as the E3's headline specifications.

Combined-cycle figures reflect standardised test conditions, and real-world distances can differ with load, weather and driving style.
